fcs_function.name: ctl/pitch-deg
fcs_function.description: both ruddervators, trailing edge down positive: nose down

fcs_function.name: ctl/roll-cmd-deg
fcs_function.description: roll command, right wing down positive

fcs_function.name: ctl/yaw-deg
fcs_function.description: ruddervators against each other, nose right positive

fcs_function.name: ctl/aileron-deg
fcs_function.description: ailerons as the aerodynamic tables take them: right trailing edge down positive, which rolls left

fcs_function.name: ctl/spoiler-norm
fcs_function.description: spoilers, 0 to 1 (1 is 45 deg), from the speedbrake command; the approach is taken to be flown at 30 deg

fcs_function.name: aero/wheel-height-ft
fcs_function.description: height of the wheels above the ground, for ground effect

switch.name: ctl/gear-norm
switch.description: gear position as the drag sees it: the command itself when ctl/instant is set (trims)

fcs_function.name: ctl/steer-deg
fcs_function.description: nose-wheel steering, 60 deg at full command
